summary.text: Candy Noble is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 89 who has served since January 8, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Angie Carraway is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Candy Noble earned a degree in education from Hardin-Simmons University and was appointed to the Texas Juvenile Justice Board, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the Texas House on January 8, 2019, and for 2023-2024 was assigned to the Human Services and Ways & Means committees.
